source: wheel odometry from the team-spec encoders (rear wheel counts + steering), counted from the reported runs' recorded wheel angles -- every reported Isaac mission run on ws1 with a SLAM log (test_runs/bd_isaac, test_runs/riibotics) plus the S2 surveys r6, r7

noise.draws: each draw counts the recorded wheel angles through another sensor unit's phases; team_spec_quantized has no INL, so the draws repeat the same counts

provenance.tool: tools/p0a_measure.py age --draws 1 --regenerate-encoder team_spec_quantized (snapshot ats_689a0208, one run per call), merged by test_runs/bd_isaac/age_merge.py
